title: Pricing: Starter, Pro and Premium Plans | AIVideosUGC
description: AIVideosUGC pricing: Starter is $24.50 a month for 200 credits, Pro is $35 for 300, and Premium is $63 for 600. Credits are what you spend on a photo or video.
h1: AIVideosUGC Pricing for Product Photos and Videos
lead: Compare pricing for product photos and short video ads. AIVideosUGC shows the credit cost of each job before you approve it.
card: Starter, Pro, and Premium, with a set credit balance each month.
intro: Starter gives you 200 credits for $24.50 per month. Pro gives you 300 for $35, and Premium gives you 600 for $63. Use the same balance for listing photos and video ads. The charge for each job shows before you confirm.
credits_explained: One product photo uses 24 credits. A 6-second video uses 24, a 10-second video uses 40, a 15-second video uses 60, and a 30-second video uses 120. You can add up to 7 reference photos. The amount appears before you confirm the job.
A job reserves its credits while it runs and charges them when the file is ready. When a job fails, the reserved credits return to your balance on their own. You do not send a ticket for that return.
teams: Need more than Premium for a shop or an agency? Email support@aivideosugc.com with how many photos and videos you make in a month, and we will suggest a setup.

faq.q: How long should I wait for a finished video?
faq.a: You see the credit cost before the job starts, and a failed job returns those credits on its own. If a file stays stuck, email support@aivideosugc.com with the time of the job. We do not promise a clock time.

faq.q: Can an AI actor hold the item I sell?
faq.a: Yes. An AI actor can hold the product, point to it, or wear it when your photo shows that item. The product in the file is the product you uploaded.

faq.q: How do I move to a larger plan?
faq.a: Move from Starter to Pro or Premium when the month needs more credits. If you do not see the switch in your account, email support@aivideosugc.com and we will help.

faq.q: How do I cancel a plan?
faq.a: Email support@aivideosugc.com to cancel. Read the [Refund Policy](/refunds) if you need a charge review. The month you already paid stays active until it ends, and new credits stop after that.

faq.q: Are there limits on ads I make here?
faq.a: You can place the download in paid ads, on your store, and in client work. Files have no AIVideosUGC watermark. Follow each platform's rules on the day you publish. [AI content trust and safety](page:trust) covers what stays in your account.

faq.q: How do I make the first video?
faq.a: Upload one product photo or paste a product link, pick an AI actor and a length, and download. The credit cost is on screen before you start.

faq.q: Can I make more than one version of a video?
faq.a: Yes. Run another job with a new actor, a new voice, or a new opening line. Each job spends its own credits: 24 for a photo or a 6-second video, 40 for 10 seconds, 60 for 15, and 120 for 30. Starter is $24.50 a month for 200 credits, Pro is $35 for 300, and Premium is $63 for 600.
